MP Police GD Constable Online Form 2026 (7500 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Constable (General Duty). This recruitment has been issued for 7500 posts. The online application process for MPESB MP Police GD Constable Recruitment 2026 will start from 22 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 06 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB MP Police GD Constable Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2026
  • Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 11 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 19 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 250/-
  • Portal Charges Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

MP Police GD Constable Online Form 2026 (7500 Posts) is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 06 October 2026.

The official website is: https://esb.mp.gov.in/e_default.html
